messages:
Jonah C: Hey team 👋 I moved to our Dublin satellite office last week. Need to update my benefits region and add my spouse (we got married in Spain). Quick q's: can I add them now? Do you need an apostille/translation for the marriage cert? Also curious if HSA stays available since I'm now on EU payroll.

Aisha (People Ops): hi @Jonah C — congrats! :tada: short answers: yes you can add your spouse, we do need certified translation + either an apostille or embassy attestation for non‑US documents. HSA depends on payroll region (more below). Please start with the benefits change form so we have an audit trail.

Jonah C: thanks. where's the form? any deadline? i want coverage effective asap.

Benefits Bot: Form submitted link: <https://redwood.intra/hr/forms/benefits-change|Benefits Change Form> — Form ID BENEFITS-CHANGE-2. Required uploads: marriage_certificate.pdf, translated_certificate.pdf, proof_of_address.pdf.

Aisha (People Ops): Deadlines: if we receive a completed form + docs before the 15th of the month, changes are effective the 1st of the next month. If after the 15th, effective the 1st of the following month. For international docs we require:
- notarized certified translation (English)
- apostille OR embassy attestation for the original (if Spain issued)
If you have trouble getting an apostille, we can accept a notarized translation + a statement from your country consulate, but that slows processing.

Priya N: also tagging payroll — @Payroll please confirm: Jonah moved to Dublin so payroll region changes too, right? HSA eligibility depends on being on US payroll (HSA = US tax-advantaged). If Jonah moves to EU payroll, we can't enroll/spend HSA through Redwood; we can discuss an equivalent commuter/EU health account option.

Jonah C: ok makes sense. i'm still on the US payroll this pay cycle but HR relocation team said we'll be on EU payroll starting Apr 1. so if i add spouse now will HSA break on Apr 1? any pro‑rata refunds or payroll deductions to watch out for?

Aisha (People Ops): Good question — if you enroll now while on US payroll, HSA elections will apply until payroll region switches. On the switch date we'll disable further HSA contributions and switch you to the EU benefits bucket; elections that require US payroll won't be usable. Deductions are pro‑rated by payroll period. We'll send a confirmation with exact amounts when Payroll processes the change. For medical/dental vision coverage: coverage will continue uninterrupted if enrollment + docs are complete before the payroll transfer cutoff (we coordinate benefits effective dates to avoid gaps).

Jonah C: i can upload the PDFs now. one more: do you need spouse's passport copy or national id too?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes please upload spouse's passport (photo page) OR national ID. For dependents/spouses with foreign docs we prefer passport. Also include proof of cohabitation if name differs (utility bill, joint lease) — only needed if last names don't match.

Benefits Bot: Checklist prefilled for Jonah: [ ] Benefits Change Form submitted, [ ] marriage cert + translated copy, [ ] apostille/attestation, [ ] spouse passport, [ ] proof of cohabitation (if applicable). Link: <https://redwood.intra/hr/checklists/dublin-relocation|relocation checklist>.

Jonah C: perfect, uploading now. thanks @Aisha, @Priya. i'll ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

Aisha (People Ops): awesome — thanks! I'll watch for the upload and confirm once Payroll schedules the EU transfer. If anything is missing i'll DM you.

Priya N: noted, will coordinate with payroll and post final confirmation in this thread.
